Name: Short Haired Haley
Author: Zoragonn101
Description:
My second attempt at editing sprites and portraits, I think she came out pretty good. The hair on the sprites could use a little work I think, but I'm glad I got it to turn out the way I wanted it.

11/10/2017
Now with your choice of the original blue eyes and my custom purple eyes.

11/12/2017
Longevity Haley now redone to have short hair as well. Only blue eyes for now. Download for this doesn't include the main file, so be sure to download that as well. The main file also features better blue eyes in the sprite that match the portraits, unlike the old turquoise that they were.
